# Model: Phaser-free loan payoff dialog copy model

## Goal (user story)

As a player, I want the congratulation's wording to be accurate and testable
so that I am told I am debt free, how much is no longer deducted each week and
how much I repaid in total over the term.

## Context

Parent: `Notify when loan is paid off` (MS-0MW1ZJDVE000MUID). Satisfies parent
AC 4. Producer Q2 = B: headline plus the weekly amount freed
(`110 coins/week`) and the total repaid (`660 coins over 6 weeks`) — no
separate interest-paid line.

## Existing state

- The project keeps copy in Phaser-free models so it can be unit-tested
  without a browser (e.g. `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary` model,
  `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanRowModel.ts`).
- The HUD loan line and the loan dialogs already derive their figures from
  `ActiveLoan` (`perTurnRepayment`, `totalRepayment`, `termTurns`).

## Desired change

1. Add `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts`: a Phaser-free module that
   turns one `TurnResult` payoff entry plus seat context into the dialog's
   copy — headline, debt-free congratulation, weekly amount no longer
   deducted and total repaid over the term.
2. Include the seat-gating predicate (human seat only, `replayMode` off, run
   not ended this turn) in the same model so the rule is testable once.
3. Reuse the same figures/labels as the HUD loan line so the dialog never
   contradicts the HUD.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` exists, imports no Phaser symbol
   and produces dialog copy for a payoff entry.
2. The copy states that the player is debt free, the weekly amount no longer
   deducted (e.g. `110 coins/week`) and the total repaid over the term (e.g.
   `660 coins over 6 weeks`), derived from the payoff entry's per-turn
   repayment, total repayment and term.
3. A single predicate (or clearly documented pair) decides whether a payoff is
   presentable: suppressed in `replayMode`, suppressed for a non-human seat,
   allowed for the human seat, and suppressed when the turn also ends the run.
4. The unit tests from the sibling test slice for the copy and the gating
   pass.
5. The model exposes everything the overlay renderer needs, so no copy string
   is duplicated in the renderer.

## Minimal Implementation

- Mirror the shape/style of the existing `MainStreetLoanRowModel.ts`.
- Take the payoff entry plus a small context object (`replayMode`, seat,
  `gameResult`) as pure inputs.
- Return a small typed result (headline, body lines, dismiss label).

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` — **new**, copy + gating model.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanRowModel.ts` — the sibling model to mirror.
- `src/MainStreetLoans.ts` — the payoff entry shape consumed.
- `src/MainStreetChallenges.ts` — `isHumanSeatCredit()` used by the gate.

## Constraints

- Phaser-free: no engine, scene or DOM import.
- No copy duplication with the HUD or the loan dialogs.

## Dependencies

- Depends on the engine slice (consumes the payoff entry shape).
data.title: Model: Phaser-free loan payoff copy model

# Browser test: rendered loan payoff dialog and dismissal

## Goal (user story)

As an agent shipping the loan-payoff notification, I want a Phaser browser test
for the rendered dialog and its dismissal, so that depth, parenting and
dismissal behaviour are pinned before the renderer is written (parent AC 9:
a browser test for the rendered dialog and its dismissal).

## Context

Parent: `Notify when loan is paid off` (MS-0MW1ZJDVE000MUID). Satisfies the
browser-test half of parent AC 9 and the overlay half of AC 5. Follows the
precedent set by `tests/main-street/MainStreetLoanOverlay.browser.test.ts` and
`tests/main-street/turn-summary-bank-loan.browser.test.ts`.

## Existing state

- Overlay conventions: `createOverlayBackground` / `createOverlayButton` from
  `@ui`, every element parented into `s.hudContainer`, depths 199/200/201,
  tracked in `s.overlayObjects`, SFX via `safePlaySound`, instant appearance.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` exposes the other dialogs
  (`showLoanOfferDialog`, `showEventChoiceDialog`, `showPiggybackDialog`).
- Existing browser tests boot Phaser headlessly and assert on the scene's
  overlay objects.

## Desired change

1. Add `tests/main-street/MainStreetLoanPayoff.browser.test.ts` which renders
   the payoff dialog through the scene's public method and asserts:
   - the dialog appears with the modelled copy (debt free, weekly amount,
     total repaid);
   - every element is parented into `s.hudContainer` at the agreed depths and
     tracked in `s.overlayObjects`;
   - a single dismiss action removes the overlay, clears the tracked objects
     and invokes the supplied continuation exactly once;
   - no fade-in (instant appearance);
   - nothing is created when the gate suppresses the dialog.
2. Reuse the existing browser-test bootstrap rather than introducing a new
   harness.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `tests/main-street/MainStreetLoanPayoff.browser.test.ts` exists — a
   browser test for the rendered dialog and its dismissal — and drives the
   dialog through the scene's public overlay method (no test-only hooks).
2. The test asserts the rendered text matches the copy model output (debt
   free, the weekly amount no longer deducted, the total repaid).
3. The test asserts overlay conventions: parented into `s.hudContainer`,
   depths 199/200/201, tracked in `s.overlayObjects`, instant appearance.
4. The test asserts that a single dismiss action removes the overlay, clears
   the tracked objects and calls the continuation exactly once.
5. The test asserts that a suppressed payoff (replay / non-human seat) creates
   no overlay objects.
6. The browser test fails before the renderer exists and passes after it.

## Minimal Implementation

- Copy the bootstrap from `MainStreetLoanOverlay.browser.test.ts`.
- Drive the scene method directly with a modelled payoff entry.
- Assert on the tracked overlay objects and a `vi.fn()` continuation.

## Key Files

- `tests/main-street/MainStreetLoanPayoff.browser.test.ts` — **new**.
- `tests/main-street/MainStreetLoanOverlay.browser.test.ts` — the bootstrap to
  copy.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — the seam under test.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` — the copy asserted.

## Constraints

- No test-only hooks added to production code.
- No new browser-test harness or dependency.

## Dependencies

- Depends on the copy-model slice (asserts its output).

# Overlay: loan payoff dialog renderer and scene delegation

## Goal (user story)

As a player, I want a congratulatory dialog to appear when my loan is fully
repaid so that I notice the milestone and know my weekly deduction has stopped.

## Context

Parent: `Notify when loan is paid off` (MS-0MW1ZJDVE000MUID). Satisfies parent
ACs 4, 5 and the rendering half of 9. Producer Q1 = A (its own modal) and Q2 =
B (headline + weekly freed + total repaid).

## Existing state

- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanOverlay.ts` renders the existing loan dialogs
  (offer/selector) using `createOverlayBackground` / `createOverlayButton`.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` is the delegation point that exposes
  each dialog (`showLoanOfferDialog`, `showEventChoiceDialog`, …), and
  `src/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` delegates the public scene methods.
- Depths 199/200/201, `s.hudContainer` parenting, `s.overlayObjects` tracking
  and `safePlaySound` are the established conventions.

## Desired change

1. Render the payoff dialog — either a new mode in
   `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanOverlay.ts` or a new
   `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffOverlay.ts` — from the copy produced by
   `MainStreetLoanPayoffModel`, following every overlay convention:
   `createOverlayBackground` / `createOverlayButton`, `hudContainer`
   parenting, depths 199/200/201, `overlayObjects` tracking, `safePlaySound`,
   instant appearance (no fade-in) and reduced-motion safety.
2. Expose `showLoanPayoffDialog(payoff, onDismiss)` on
   `MainStreetOverlayContent` and delegate it from `MainStreetScene`.
3. A single dismiss action clears the overlay and invokes the continuation
   exactly once.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A payoff dialog renderer exists and is driven only by the copy model's
   output — no copy string is invented in the renderer.
2. The overlay uses `createOverlayBackground` / `createOverlayButton`, parents
   every element into `s.hudContainer`, uses depths 199/200/201, tracks the
   objects in `s.overlayObjects` and plays SFX through `safePlaySound`.
3. The dialog appears instantly (no fade-in) and is reduced-motion safe;
   it follows the project's overlay conventions (instant appearance,
   reduced-motion safe, single dismiss action) and never presents in
   `replayMode` / headless runs.
4. `MainStreetOverlayContent` exposes `showLoanPayoffDialog(payoff,
   onDismiss)` and `MainStreetScene` delegates it, matching the existing
   dialog methods.
5. A single dismiss action that resumes exactly the flow it interrupted
   removes the overlay, clears the tracked objects and calls `onDismiss`
   exactly once; there is no other button.
6. The browser test from the sibling slice passes, and existing loan overlay
   browser tests still pass.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add a payoff mode/method next to the existing loan dialogs, reusing their
  helpers.
- Compose the text from `MainStreetLoanPayoffModel` output.
- Wire `showLoanPayoffDialog` through `MainStreetOverlayContent` and
  `MainStreetScene`.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanOverlay.ts` — add the payoff dialog mode, or
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffOverlay.ts` — **new** if a separate module
  reads better.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — expose `showLoanPayoffDialog()`.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` — delegate the new method.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` — the copy consumed.
- `src/ui/` — `createOverlayBackground` / `createOverlayButton` helpers.

## Constraints

- Follow the overlay conventions exactly (AGENTS.md UI best practices).
- One modal at a time — the renderer must not create its own stacking that
  lets other dialog buttons be pressed.

## Dependencies

- Depends on the browser-test slice (tests first) and the copy-model slice.

# Turn flow: present payoff dialog before the End of Turn summary

## Goal (user story)

As a player, I want the congratulation to interrupt the flow at a natural
moment and hand me straight on to the End of Turn summary, so that I never
miss it and never lose my place.

## Context

Parent: `Notify when loan is paid off` (MS-0MW1ZJDVE000MUID). Satisfies parent
ACs 2, 3, 6 and 7. Producer Q1 = A (its own modal immediately after the
closing animations, dismissing into the End of Turn summary) and Q3 = A (human
seat only, via `isHumanSeatCredit`).

## Existing state

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` owns the closing →
  summary → next-turn sequence. `presentTurnSummaryGate()` is the single place
  the End of Turn summary is presented; `completeDeferredClosingTail()`
  completes the turn after deferred work (bailout, piggyback, event choice).
- `replayMode` guards are already used at this layer to suppress UI.
- `isHumanSeatCredit()` in `src/MainStreetChallenges.ts` already encodes the
  human-seat presentation gate and is used by the challenge celebration.

## Desired change

1. After the closing animations complete and *before* the End of Turn summary,
   present the payoff dialog for each reported payoff, once per payoff.
2. On dismissal, continue into exactly the flow that would have run without
   the dialog: the End of Turn summary when that gate applies, otherwise the
   normal next-week flow.
3. Suppress entirely in `replayMode` and for non-human seats (via
   `isHumanSeatCredit`), and skip the dialogue when the same closing ends the
   run in a win or loss (the game-over overlay wins).
4. Never duplicate a payoff when the closing is resumed/deferred — one dialog
   per payoff, not per turn.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. In single-player exactly one congratulatory dialog is presented per retired
   loan; a later, separate payoff produces exactly one more, and a
   resumed/deferred closing never duplicates a dialog.
2. The dialog is presented after the closing animations and before the End of
   Turn summary; dismissing it continues into the summary (or, where that gate
   is skipped, the normal next-week flow) exactly as it would have without the
   dialog.
3. Competitive play presents the dialog for the human seat only, gated
   through the existing `isHumanSeatCredit` seam (producer Q3 = A); an AI
   seat's payoff changes nothing visible for the player. The dialog is
   suppressed in `replayMode` and for non-human seats.
4. A closing that ends the run in the same turn presents the game-over overlay
   instead — a congratulation never pre-empts a win/loss summary.
5. No more than one modal is ever active: the summary's buttons are never
   reachable while the payoff dialog is up.
6. The unit tests from the sibling test slice covering the no-duplicate and
   sequencing rules pass.

## Minimal Implementation

- Read `TurnResult`'s payoff field after the closing in the turn-flow layer.
- Filter with the model's presentation predicate, then present sequentially.
- Pass a continuation into the dismiss handler that calls the existing
  `presentTurnSummaryGate()` / next-week path unchanged.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` — the sequencing change.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` — the presentation predicate.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — `showLoanPayoffDialog()` invoked.
- `src/MainStreetChallenges.ts` — `isHumanSeatCredit()` gate.
- `src/MainStreetEngineTypes.ts` — the `TurnResult` payoff field consumed.

## Constraints

- Do not change the existing summary, bailout, event-choice or next-week flows
  beyond inserting the dialog ahead of them.
- No new state mutation and no new RNG consumption.

## Dependencies

- Depends on the overlay slice and the copy-model slice.
data.title: Turn flow: present payoff dialog before End of Turn summary

# Docs: loan payoff notification and pinned doc tests

## Goal (user story)

As a maintainer or player reading the rules, I want the payoff notification
documented alongside the loan rules and the UX dialog conventions so that the
behaviour is discoverable and the prose stays pinned by tests.

## Context

Parent: `Notify when loan is paid off` (MS-0MW1ZJDVE000MUID). Satisfies parent
ACs 10 and 11. Existing precedent: `tests/main-street/loan-docs.test.ts` and
`tests/main-street/turn-summary-bank-loan-docs.test.ts` already pin loan prose.

## Existing state

- `docs/game/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` §5.1 documents bank loans including
  the repayment rule; the payoff notification belongs there.
- `docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md` documents the dialog/overlay conventions.
- `README` and `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` describe engine/scene conventions.
- Pinned prose tests assert specific sentences in those documents.

## Desired change

1. Add the payoff notification rule to `docs/game/core-rules-and-mechanics.md`
   §5.1: a retired loan is announced once, after the closing animations and
   before the End of Turn summary; the dialog states debt free, the weekly
   amount no longer deducted and the total repaid; it is presentation-only.
2. Add a dialog section to `docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md` describing the
   overlay (conventions, single dismiss action, reduced-motion safety,
   `replayMode` suppression, human-seat-only in competitive play).
3. Update the pinned doc tests for the new/changed prose, and update the
   `README` and code comments where the behaviour is described.
4. `CHANGELOG.md` is out of scope — it is managed by the release pipeline.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes: code comments,
   `README`, and the relevant `docs/` entries
   (`docs/game/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` §5.1 and
   `docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md`) — §5.1 documents the payoff notification:
   per-payoff announcement, placement after the closing animations and before
   the End of Turn summary, and that it is presentation-only with no state or
   RNG change.
2. `docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md` has a section describing the payoff dialog's
   overlay conventions, single dismiss action, reduced-motion safety,
   `replayMode` suppression and human-seat-only competitive gating.
3. The pinned documentation tests are updated to match the new prose and pass.
4. `README` and the relevant code comments reflect the new behaviour.
5. No stale documentation contradicts the shipped behaviour; `CHANGELOG.md` is
   left untouched.
6. The full project test suite passes with all documentation changes (parent
   AC 11).

## Minimal Implementation

- Add the rule to §5.1 next to the repayment rule.
- Add the dialog section following neighbouring dialog sections' structure.
- Extend the existing pinned-prose tests rather than adding a new file, unless
  the new prose is large enough to warrant one.

## Key Files

- `docs/game/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` — §5.1 payoff rule.
- `docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md` — new dialog section.
- `tests/main-street/loan-docs.test.ts` — pinned loan prose.
- `tests/main-street/turn-summary-bank-loan-docs.test.ts` — pinned dialog
  prose.
- `README.md` — behaviour summary entry.
- `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` — engine documentation conventions, if affected.

## Constraints

- Documentation only; no production behaviour change in this slice.
- `CHANGELOG.md` is out of scope (release pipeline owns it).

## Dependencies

- Depends on the turn-flow slice (documenting the shipped sequence).

data.comment: Cross-slice contract: tests/main-street/MainStreetLoanPayoff.browser.test.ts (MS-0MW3SN0IT008TQU3) is authored **red-phase** per the repo's documented convention (panel-opacity / hud-total-counting): each case is `it.fails` while `MainStreetScene.showLoanPayoffDialog` does not exist, so the tree stays green and the pin can never go stale. This slice must flip each `it.fails` to a plain `it` when the renderer lands (AC6 here), and the browser file is already wired into the `main-street-overlay-dialogs` group in .pi/test-config.json. Agreed seam: `showLoanPayoffDialog(payoff, onDismiss)` derives its context from the scene (replayMode, payoff.ownerId, state.players, state.gameResult) and builds copy via `buildLoanPayoffContent`; suppression is the model's gate.
